takeaways: The strongest unused material is the South Hills (SAM) photo shoot: the glowing cold-plunge float (cell 58, a 5) and the red-light silhouettes (cells 7, 54) should be the Iron 24 cover image and lead stills on work/iron-24, alongside the Block 3/4 red-light profile (cell 8). Block 2 Vertical has six strong action portraits (barbell close-up, overhead press, orange-wall cable curl) that fit work/iron-24 and service:organic-social. For the hero loop, the best new clips are in the raw graded folders: Niki laughing on the treadmill (Niki/Video 6), the Chelsea red-light close-up (Chelsea/Video 5), the Alex plunge face close-up (Alex/Video 6), and the orange-wall machine shot (Block 2 Landscape clips 34). The clean no-logo Gym Walkthrough can supply 3-5 s facility cutaways. The five Assessment Reels are static talking-head tutorials and not worth featuring. The influencer Photos folders are duplicate copies of the corporate selects, so pick from the corporate folders to avoid double-listing. The two Example Content folders are stock and reference material (with stock watermarks), not Stoop work.
